instruction: I'm configuring my academic homepage with the academicpages template in ~/Code/Website. I want to add my academic profile links in the _config.yaml file. Please navigate to the author section and update the orcid field to "http://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789" and the googlescholar field to "https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=ABCD1234".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to update academic profile URLs in the YAML configuration. The agent must locate the 'author.orcid' and 'author.googlescholar' fields in _config.yml and update them to the specified URLs. The evaluator uses the existing check_json metric with is_yaml=true to verify these two academic profile fields. The task maintains the same complexity as the original - locating and editing specific YAML configuration fields.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both required fields (author.orcid and author.googlescholar) from the instruction
Correct getter logic: get_vm_file correctly retrieves the YAML file from VM to local cache and returns the file path
Correct metric logic: check_json with is_yaml=true properly parses YAML files and validates nested keys using exact match
Expected values match instruction: Both URL values exactly match what the instruction requires
Proper postconfig: Includes Ctrl+S to save the file before verification, ensuring changes are persisted
Type compatibility: Static warning about type mismatch is false positive - get_vm_file returns string path when multi=False (default), which matches check_json's expected string parameter
Logical data flow: postconfig saves → get_vm_file retrieves → check_json parses YAML → rules verify both fields with exact match

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
